image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a white and grey electric steam iron against a black background. The iron is positioned vertically, resting on its heel rest. Visible features include the handle, temperature control buttons/dial area, a translucent water window, and the rear section of the body. A grey power cord extends upwards from the rear. The soleplate is partially visible at the bottom left, showing a metallic tip.

artifact_observations.location: Lower front body, near the soleplate junction
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a cluster of black markings that attempt to resemble text or a brand logo but resolve into nonsensical, alien-like glyphs upon close inspection. This is a common AI artifact where the model mimics the presence of text without rendering legible characters.

The texture of the power cord appears slightly overly detailed or 'noisy' compared to the smooth plastic of the body, lacking the clear braided or rubber definition expected, appearing somewhat melted into the background at the very top.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as an iron and not a similar handheld appliance (e.g., steamer).
To rigorously analyze the gibberish text artifact observed on the front body and determine if it constitutes a failure in text rendering.
To check for boundary bleeding between the white plastic body and the black background, and to ensure the cord is a separate topological entity connected correctly.
To assess the overall realism of lighting and reflections on the plastic and metal surfaces.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of the pseudo-text on the front body.
Physical connection point of the power cord to the handle.
Reflection consistency on the curved plastic surfaces.
Sharpness of the soleplate tip against the background.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text' on the front of the iron. Is it just blurry, or is it structurally nonsensical? Also, verify if the power cord's entry point into the handle looks physically plausible or if it seems to float/fuse.
